author: Hemant
review_text: eSewa's KYC process has been frustrating. My KYC was rejected because my ID is linked to an old account, which I can’t access due to an inactive SIM. Despite submitting all required documents—live selfie, front and back of my ID, and photos of both eSewa accounts—they still insist that my old account balance be zero. How is this possible without access? This verification process is overly complicated, and support has been unhelpful. I wouldn’t recommend eSewa to anyone facing similar issues.
